rule: Guidebook tips use only '## ' headings, paragraphs, **bold**, '- ' bullets and '> ' callouts: no tables, links, images or HTML.

cases.name: link
cases.expect: unit-1.json › guidebook › tipsMd: line 3: links and images are not supported

cases.name: image
cases.expect: unit-1.json › guidebook › tipsMd: line 1: links and images are not supported

cases.name: table
cases.expect: unit-1.json › guidebook › tipsMd: line 1: tables are not supported

cases.name: html
cases.expect: unit-1.json › guidebook › tipsMd: line 1: HTML is not supported

cases.name: level-3-heading
cases.expect: unit-1.json › guidebook › tipsMd: line 1: headings must be level 2 ('## ')

cases.name: italic
cases.expect: unit-1.json › guidebook › tipsMd: line 1: only balanced **bold** emphasis is supported

cases.name: numbered-list
cases.expect: unit-1.json › guidebook › tipsMd: line 1: numbered lists are not supported, use '- ' bullets
